card.headline: *tziortzis* ends fifth in euronascar open.
card.deck: The Cypriot driver raced his Ford Mustang in both NASCAR Euro Series divisions and finished fifth in the OPEN standings.

people.name: Vladimiros Tziortzis
people.meta: EuroNASCAR OPEN and V8GP · Ford Mustang
people.text: Podiums at Paul Ricard in May and Vallelunga in September. The season ended at Zolder in Belgium.

caption:
Vladimiros Tziortzis has finished fifth in the 2026 EuroNASCAR OPEN standings. 🏁

The Cypriot driver raced his Ford Mustang in both NASCAR Euro Series divisions this year, OPEN and V8GP.

His podiums came at Paul Ricard in May and Vallelunga in September, and the season closed at Zolder in Belgium last weekend.

What should he aim for next year? 🇨🇾

Source: NASCAR Euro Series, Cyprus Mail, Politis
@vladimirostziortzis
